# Best portable power stations for a CPAP

Most CPAPs draw about 40 W, or about 90 W with the heated humidifier on. Any pure sine wave station can run one, so the real differences are nights per charge, noise, and how fast it switches over if the grid drops while you sleep. None of these sources tested the units hands-on. They work from manufacturer specs and runtime math.

## My picks

**1. Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2: best overall (~$700)**
- It has 1,024 Wh, is rated at about 20 dB under 200 W, and has a 10 ms UPS switchover. It recharges in about 49 minutes and weighs 24.9 lb.
- Expect about 2.7 nights with the humidifier off, or about 1.7 with it on ([Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/)). BuyerSheet's more conservative math gives about 1.2 humidified nights ([BuyerSheet](https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/)).
- The results gave me no direct store link for this one. BuyerSheet lists it with Amazon and official-store links: https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/

**2. BLUETTI AC180: best value (~$449 to $499)**
- It has 1,152 Wh and 1,800 W output. That works out to about 3.1 nights without the humidifier and 1.4 with it ([BuyerSheet](https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/)).
- It lists at $499 on Bluetti's store. Code AFF5OFF took it to $474.05 when tested on 2026-10-21, though codes can change ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/bluetti-discount-codes)). PowerStationBench shows $449 on Amazon ([PowerStationBench](https://powerstationbench.com/best/power-station-for-cpap)).
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180. This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Weight is reported inconsistently, from 16.5 lb to 35.3 lb, so check the product page. I also didn't see a UPS switchover spec for it in these results.

**3. EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus: best if you want to expand (~$719)**
- It matches the Anker on capacity and UPS speed, stays under 30 dB up to 600 W, and expands to 5 kWh, which is about 8 humidified nights ([Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/)).
- It weighs 27.6 lb. Prices and links are on [BuyerSheet](https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/).

**4. Budget or travel: EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus (~$279 to $299)**
- At 286 Wh and 10.4 lb, it covers about one night with the humidifier off but not a humidified night unless you add the extra battery ([Outage Power Guide](https://outagepowerguide.com/reviews/best-power-station-for-cpap-machines/), [Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/)).

## Things to check
- **Jackery:** Jackery says its power stations aren't recommended for medical devices. Ask your CPAP maker before choosing the Explorer 1000 v2 ([Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/)).
- **Sizing:** Aim for at least two nights. The formula is nightly Wh × nights ÷ 0.85. For example, 520 Wh × 2 ÷ 0.85 is about 1,220 Wh with the humidifier on.
- **DC cord:** Your CPAP maker's 12 V DC cord skips the inverter and adds roughly 10 to 20% runtime. Don't use generic car adapters.
- **Humidifier:** Turning it off during an outage stretches a charge the most.

If you tell me your CPAP model and whether you use the humidifier, I can narrow this to one pick.
